description: This file provides functions to initialize, manage, and interact with UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) contexts and configurations within a larger software project. It includes functions for allocation, setting directories, reading, writing, adding, deleting, and iterating over UCI sections and options.

methods.name: int bbfdm_init_uci_ctx(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx)
methods.description: Initializes the UCI context within a given bbfdm_ctx structure, allocating resources and optionally setting configuration and save directories.

methods.name: int bbfdm_free_uci_ctx(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx)
methods.description: Frees the UCI context resources associated with a given bbfdm_ctx structure.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_get_buf(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,const char * default_value,char * buffer,size_t buffer_size)
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI option value into a buffer, with default fallback, based on specified package, section, and option identifiers.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_get(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,char ** value)
methods.description: Gets a string value from UCI for the specified package, section, and option, returning a dynamically allocated copy.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_get_fallback_def(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,const char * default_value,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI option value, falling back to a default if not found, with dynamic memory allocation for output.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_get_by_section_buf(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,struct uci_section * section,const char * option,const char * default_value,char * buffer,size_t buffer_size)
methods.description: Retrieves an option value from a specific UCI section buffer, or returns a default if not present.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_get_by_section(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,struct uci_section * section,const char * option,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves an option value from a specific UCI section with dynamic memory allocation.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_set(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,const char * value)
methods.description: Sets a UCI option value within a specified package and section.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_add(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * type,struct uci_section ** s)
methods.description: Adds a new section of a given type to a UCI package, creating an empty UCI file if necessary.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_delete(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * section,const char * option)
methods.description: Deletes a specific UCI configuration entry within a package, section, and optionally an option.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_delete_section(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,struct uci_section * s)
int bbfdm_uci_commit_package(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package)
methods.description: Commits all changes within a specified UCI package.

methods.name: struct:uci_section * bbfdm_uci_walk_section(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * type,struct uci_section * prev_section)
methods.description: Iterates over UCI sections of a given type within a package, optionally starting from a previous section.
